name: 夕阳再现·风云再起Ⅱ
english_name: Sunset Reappears: Storm Rises Again II
english_description: The site's subtitle is "Storm Rises Again II" (domain www.zhaoshu.net). It belongs to the same Sunset Reappears family of wuxia MUD engines as this project's xyzxfk (Crazy Jianghu) — the two share some underlying files, but their login, security, and world content were developed independently as two separate games built on a common engine. This branch carries the genuine Sunset Reappears map lineage (byte-identical to xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412), unlike another cluster of similarly-branded archives in this collection whose maps actually belong to an unrelated "Tianya" family.
